subject.title: Feature: Project trees + threaded entry points in Control UI

question: What scope should OpenClaw core own for Control UI project/thread management: project tree navigation, composer route targets or fanout, selected-message split/move, and seed/copy behavior, and which pieces should instead land under the first-class Projects tracker?
rationale: The missing behavior spans UI hierarchy, Gateway protocol, persisted session metadata, transcript copy/mutation semantics, and overlapping open product trackers, so automation cannot choose the permanent data model or user workflow boundary safely.

options.title: Design Additive Session/Project MVP
options.body: Add a narrow core MVP for project-tree navigation plus explicit route-target and split/seed semantics while reusing sessions, parentSessionKey, checkpoint branches, and reply metadata where appropriate.

options.title: Fold Project Tree Into Projects
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13676 own durable Project identity and project/session bindings first, then keep this issue for split/fanout/seed UX only.

options.title: Defer Split/Fanout
options.body: Keep current flat session management and postpone split/move/fanout until maintainers settle transcript mutation and cross-session routing semantics.

recommendation.title: Design Additive Session/Project MVP
recommendation.body: Add a narrow core MVP for project-tree navigation plus explicit route-target and split/seed semantics while reusing sessions, parentSessionKey, checkpoint branches, and reply metadata where appropriate.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the project owner in CONTRIBUTING.md and has the strongest recent history across the current session UI, Gateway protocol, and prior keep-open routing comments.
